holiday-promo-poster 1.0.0

- Initial release of an AI-powered tool for generating holiday promotional posters using the Mew design API.
- Guides users to provide all required assets (API key, product image URL, campaign copy, target holiday, and style choice).
- Ensures product images are enhanced for seasonal appeal before creating the final poster.
- Provides clear instructions for image URL requirements and privacy tradeoffs for uploading local images.
- Offers five distinct visual styles for posters, mapped directly to available Mew presets.
- Enforces strong visual and usability checks for holiday theme, style, and text readability on final outputs.
